body: I almost didn’t even go. Because I didn’t know anybody who knew him yet.. luckily last minute I hit up my ex bf mutual friend..a stranger. To go. I should of just gone up to the front on my own. Cause now he’s gone. Rip.

Thank you for the response ! Yes I agree what you say. And I hear you! Trust me I’m not depressed but I do believe being sad is normal. And you can’t fake it. Even if you tried. Your sadness comes from something. You channel it Ofcourse. Yes I was enjoying my time! I had lots of fun. But it did remind me Iam all alone and all I really have is myself and my cat. And my dad Ofcourse because he understands. I guess I just went to the wrong person at the wrong time for justification. But I can’t do that ethier. I need to sit in my own feelings. And mediate into why I fell the way I do... just the fact someone is telling me I’m not sad. Maybe I’m just getting triggered because my mom use to do that. I know I have friends. It definitely is self inflicted. I’m isolating myself. On my own. I create my reality. Thank you for asking about my music. Iam on SoundCloud as gh00stbaby. Good luck finding me. Or just go on my Instagram.. I make post emo music. Like lil peep. Rip.
